dataset: PY2026 (and PY2025 comparison) QPP quality benchmark decile cutpoints for the APP Plus five eCQM/MIPS CQM/Medicare CQM measures

collection_type_naming_in_file.note: Verbatim values in the 'Collection Type' column of the QPP benchmarks CSV.
collection_type_naming_in_file.warning: Medicare CQM rows carry a DIFFERENT Measure ID string, e.g. '001SSP (Only available for SSP ACOs reporting the APP Plus)'. Measures 112 and 113 non-Medicare-CQM rows use e.g. '113 (Not available in Traditional MIPS)'. Joining on Measure ID requires normalizing these suffixes.

benchmark_type_column_caveat: The CSV's 'Benchmark Type' column only ever contains 'Historical' or '--'; it NEVER says 'Flat'. Flat-percentage benchmarks are labelled 'Historical' in this file. 'benchmark_type_effective' below is derived by matching the decile array against the canonical flat-percentage decile pattern, and is corroborated by CMS prose (see sources in benchmarks-py2026.md).

decile_parse_semantics.entry: The performance rate you must reach to land in that decile: the LOWER bound for normal measures, the UPPER bound for inverse measures (001).
decile_parse_semantics.empty: true means the CSV cell was '--' (decile collapsed away, typical of topped-out measures).
